versions.changelog:
Universal Intelligence Agent v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Integrates 16 search engines (domestic + international) for comprehensive information retrieval with no API key required.
- Features automated end-to-end workflow: multi-engine search → intelligent web scraping with anti-blocking → NLP & free LLM analysis → structured decision report.
- Implements robust state management with WAL protocol, transaction boundaries, and cross-session recovery for lossless operation.
- Intelligent source credibility scoring, auto-matched decision frameworks, and multi-format report outputs (brief & deep analysis).
- Zero-configuration setup; all paths non-hardcoded, strong contract enforcement, circuit breakers, and full self-test/health check before every run.
